# PolyAI appoints Sunil Shah as Chief Financial Officer

Former Rapid7 finance leader and technology investor brings 20 years of experience growing software businesses to scale frontier dialog for enterprises and builders.

**NEW YORK – October 8, 2026 –** [PolyAI](https://poly.ai/), the leader in frontier dialog for the enterprise, today announced the appointment of Sunil Shah as Chief Financial Officer. Shah most recently served as Senior Vice President of Finance at Rapid7, and he joins PolyAI at a pivotal moment as it opens up its Agentic Dialog Platform to more enterprises and AI builders.

As CFO, Shah will lead PolyAI's global finance organization, including financial planning, accounting, treasury, and revenue operations, and will help shape the company's capital strategy. His initial focus is investing in PolyAI's Agentic Dialog Platform to make it as accessible as possible to customers.

The appointment follows PolyAI's launches of [Dialog-RSN-1](https://poly.ai/dialog-rsn-1), the world's fastest reasoning model for real-time complex dialog, and [Wren](https://poly.ai/wren), its in-platform agent that constantly finds ways to improve dialog agents so their performance compounds over time.

"With the advent of true dialog AI, every company needs to rethink how it engages with its customers," said Shah. "PolyAI's agentic platform is easy enough for any builder to start with, and now with Wren, is one of the most scalable dialog platforms for large enterprises to continually improve customer engagement and business outcomes."

Shah brings two decades of experience at the intersection of technology, finance, and capital markets. At Rapid7, he led the global finance organization spanning FP&A, strategic finance, investor relations, and data analytics, helping the company scale from $300 million to $800 million in annual recurring revenue. Before that, Shah ran strategic finance at Imperva, a global leader in data and application security, and supported the company's eventual acquisition for over $2 billion. Prior to moving into operating roles, Shah spent nearly a decade as a technology investor at firms including Surveyor Capital and Carlson Capital.

"Enterprises want a dialog platform they can build on today and grow with for years," said Nikola Mrkšić, CEO and co-founder of PolyAI. "Sunil has helped steer software companies through the kind of growth we're heading into, and he knows the business from both sides of the table as an investor and an operator. We're thrilled to welcome him to the leadership team."

Learn more about frontier dialog at [poly.ai](https://poly.ai/).

## About PolyAI

[PolyAI](https://poly.ai/) is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Proven on more than a billion conversations and powered by our proprietary model Dialog-RSN-1, our agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. We serve hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.
